question: Rani Machaiah was awarded with 'Padam Shri' in the year __________ for her contribution to folk dance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2023**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rani Machaiah** was awarded the prestigious **'Padam Shri'** in the year **2023**__ for her significant contributions to folk dance.
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in the Republic of India, awarded to citizens for their distinguished contributions in various fields, including the arts.
 
• Rani Machaiah's work in preserving and promoting traditional folk dance forms has been widely recognized and celebrated.
 
• The award highlights the importance of cultural heritage and the role of artists in keeping traditional art forms alive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Awards** are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day and are conferred by the President of India at a ceremonial function held at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
 
• They are given in three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (for distinguished service of higher order), and **Padma Shri** (for distinguished service).
 
• The awards were instituted in the year 1954 and have since been a significant recognition of exceptional talent and service in India.
 
• Rani Machaiah's recognition serves as an inspiration for other artists and cultural practitioners in the country.
